info.name: Remote Address Details Company Managers API

params.name: company_id
params.description: A Company ID to filter the results (only applicable for Integration Partners).

params.name: page
params.description: Starts fetching records after the given page

params.name: page_size
params.description: Change the amount of records returned per page, defaults to 20, limited to 100

items.docs:
List all company managers of an integration. If filtered by the company_id param,
it lists only company managers belonging to the specified company.


## Scopes

| Category | Read only Scope | Write only Scope (read access implicit) |
|---|---|---|
| Manage company resources (`company_admin`) | View managers (`company_manager:read`) | Manage managers (`company_manager:write`) |

info.name: Create and invite a Company Manager

params.name: actions
params.description:
Complementary action(s) to perform when creating a company manager:

- `no_invite` skips the email invitation step

items.docs:
Create a Company Manager and sends the invitation email for signing in to the Remote Platform.
